glossary.scope: As used in sections 155.30 to 155.36 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 155.30 - [Former R.C. 1509.70, amended and renumbered by H.B. 110 of the 134th General Assembly, effective 9/30/2021] Definitions.

glossary.definition: (B) "Gross landowner royalty" means a royalty based on the proceeds received on the sale of production of oil or gas without deduction for post-production costs, but less a proportionate share of any and all taxes and government fees levied on or as a result of the production.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 155.30 to 155.36 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 155.30 - [Former R.C. 1509.70, amended and renumbered by H.B. 110 of the 134th General Assembly, effective 9/30/2021] Definitions.

glossary.definition: (C) "Post-production costs" means all costs and expenses incurred between the wellhead and the point of sale, including, without limitation, the costs of any treating, separating, dehydrating, processing, storing, gathering, transporting, compressing, and marketing.
glossary.scope: As used in sections 155.30 to 155.36 of the Revised Code:
glossary.source_title: Section 155.30 - [Former R.C. 1509.70, amended and renumbered by H.B. 110 of the 134th General Assembly, effective 9/30/2021] Definitions.

glossary.definition:
(D) "State agency" means both of the following:

(1) "State agency" as defined in section 1.60 of the Revised Code;

(2) "State university or college" as defined in section 3345.12 of the Revised Code.
